t-7000.author: alice-pdx
t-7000.title: Solid oak dining table + 4 chairs - $220 (Alder District)
t-7000.body: Oak table 60x36, seats six with the leaf, four matching chairs. One chair has a wobble, easy fix. Pickup only, second floor walk-up, bring a friend. Cash. No holds.

replies.author: sellr_7731
replies.body: Still available? Can pick up Saturday.

replies.author: alice-pdx
replies.body: Yes, Saturday works. Reply with a time.

t-7001.author: stjohns_mike
t-7001.title: IKEA Kallax 4x4 white - $60 (St. Johns)
t-7001.body: Assembled, minor scuff on one corner. Disassemble it yourself or bring a van. Text preferred.

t-7002.author: quietstreet
t-7002.title: Mid-century dresser, 6 drawer, walnut veneer - $180 (Belmont)
t-7002.body: Real 1960s piece, drawers glide, veneer good except a water ring on top. Photo in person. Will not ship. Price firm.

t-7003.author: bob_m
t-7003.title: Surly Cross-Check 56cm, steel, 1x10 - $650 (Hawthorne)
t-7003.body: Cross-Check frame, built up as a commuter: 1x10, 38mm tyres, fenders, rear rack. New chain and cassette this spring. Test ride with ID. Priced to sell, not to haggle.

replies.author: tuneup_tony
replies.body: Which crank? If it is the original I know someone looking.

replies.author: bob_m
replies.body: Original Surly crank, 40t ring. Send them over.

t-7004.author: stjohns_mike
t-7004.title: Kids' bike 20 inch, Trek Precaliber - $90 (St. Johns)
t-7004.body: Outgrown. Blue, coaster brake plus hand brake, tyres hold air. Helmet included if it fits.

t-7005.author: sellr_7731
t-7005.title: Peloton bike, original model, works - $300 (Foster-Powell)
t-7005.body: Bought 2022, ridden maybe fifty times. Screen works, needs your own subscription. You haul. Cash only.

replies.author: hawthorne_hh
replies.body: Would you take 250?

replies.author: sellr_7731
replies.body: 300, no holds, first with cash.

t-7006.author: vinylguy
t-7006.title: 27 inch 4K monitor, Dell U2723QE, USB-C - $280 (Alder District)
t-7006.body: Two years old, no dead pixels, comes with the stand and the USB-C cable. Selling because I went ultrawide. Firm.

t-7007.author: alice-pdx
t-7007.title: ThinkPad T14 gen 3, 32GB, 1TB, Linux - $520 (Alder District)
t-7007.body: Ryzen 7, fresh install of whatever you want or blank. Battery at 88 percent health. Charger included. Local pickup, will demo.

replies.author: k_hiring
replies.body: Does the keyboard have the backlight?

replies.author: alice-pdx
replies.body: Yes, backlit, US layout.

t-7008.author: vinylguy
t-7008.title: Vinyl lot - 40 records, jazz and soul, mostly VG+ - $150 (Hawthorne)
t-7008.body: Not splitting the lot. List available on request. Blue Note reissues, some originals, one Coltrane with a seam split. Priced for a quick sale.

t-7009.author: sellr_7731
t-7009.title: Free: moving boxes, about 30, plus packing paper (Foster-Powell)
t-7009.body: On the porch at the corner of 62nd and Foster from Saturday morning. Take what you want. Gone when gone.

t-7010.author: nw_landlord
t-7010.title: 1BR apartment, top floor, laundry in building - $1,450/mo (Belmont)
t-7010.body: 650 sq ft, hardwood, gas range, radiator heat included. Cats OK with deposit, no dogs. Twelve-month lease, first and deposit. Showings Thursday and Saturday, reply for a slot.

replies.author: carol_nk
replies.body: Is there bike parking in the building?

replies.author: nw_landlord
replies.body: Covered rack in the back, locked gate.

t-7011.author: nw_landlord
t-7011.title: Studio, ground floor, near the streetcar - $1,100/mo (Alder District)
t-7011.body: 420 sq ft, murphy bed stays, water and trash included, electric is yours. No smoking. Available October 1.

t-7012.author: hawthorne_hh
t-7012.title: Room in 4BR house, shared bath, garden - $780/mo (Hawthorne)
t-7012.body: Four of us, ages 26 to 34, two work from home. Room is 11x12 with a closet, second floor, street-facing. Utilities split five ways, about 60 a month. Looking for someone who does their dishes. Six-month minimum.

replies.author: quietstreet
replies.body: Is the room available before the first?

replies.author: hawthorne_hh
replies.body: Current housemate leaves the 25th, so yes.

t-7013.author: stjohns_mike
t-7013.title: Detached garage for storage or workshop - $250/mo (St. Johns)
t-7013.body: Single car garage, power, no water, alley access, roll-up door with a new lock. No living in it, no autobody. Month to month.

t-7014.author: k_hiring
t-7014.title: Bakery counter staff, mornings, $19/hr + tips (Downtown)
t-7014.body: Shifts 06:00-13:00, four or five days, weekends required. Espresso experience a plus, not required; we train. Health stipend after 90 days. Reply with availability, no resume needed.

replies.author: hawthorne_hh
replies.body: Are the weekend shifts the same hours?

replies.author: k_hiring
replies.body: Saturday and Sunday are 06:00-14:00.

t-7015.author: gigs.pdx
t-7015.title: Warehouse associate, days, full time - $22/hr (Northwest Industrial)
t-7015.body: Receiving and pick/pack for a small e-commerce warehouse. Forklift cert a plus. Lift 50 lb. Benefits after 60 days. Interviews this week.

t-7016.author: carol_nk
t-7016.title: Part-time bookkeeper for a small engineering shop, remote OK - $35/hr (Alder District)
t-7016.body: Ten hours a week, monthly close, payroll through a provider, one bank account. Must know accrual basis. Send a short note about what you have done, not a resume.

t-7017.author: gigs.pdx
t-7017.title: Event crew for Saturday load-in/load-out - $150 cash (Convention Center)
t-7017.body: Two shifts, 07:00-11:00 and 21:00-01:00, either or both. Lifting, hauling, following directions. Closed-toe shoes. Reply with which shift.

replies.author: stjohns_mike
replies.body: Both shifts, have my own gloves.

replies.author: gigs.pdx
replies.body: You are on the list, check messages for the address.

t-7018.author: quietstreet
t-7018.title: Need someone to move a piano across the room - $80 (Belmont)
t-7018.body: Upright piano, one room to the next, hardwood floors, no stairs. Two people ideally. Sunday afternoon.

t-7019.author: vinylguy
t-7019.title: Photographer for a 40th birthday, 2 hours - $200 (Hawthorne)
t-7019.body: Backyard party, about thirty people, golden hour. Candids, not portraits. Share the raw files after. Show me a few examples in your reply.

t-7020.author: lostcat_fp
t-7020.title: LOST CAT - grey tabby, white chest, 'Miso' - (Foster-Powell)
t-7020.body: Missing since Tuesday night near 65th and Holgate. Grey tabby, white bib and paws, green collar with a bell, chipped. Shy but will come to food. Please check garages and sheds. Reward.

replies.author: sellr_7731
replies.body: Saw a grey tabby with a bell behind the laundromat on 67th this morning.

replies.author: lostcat_fp
replies.body: Checking now, thank you.

replies.author: lostcat_fp
replies.body: FOUND. She was in a neighbour's shed two doors down. Thank you everyone.

t-7021.author: quietstreet
t-7021.title: Found: set of keys with a red carabiner, Laurelhurst Park (Belmont)
t-7021.body: Found on the path near the pond Sunday. Describe the other keychain and they are yours.

t-7022.author: gigs.pdx
t-7022.title: Free outdoor movie Friday: 'The Princess Bride', dusk (St. Johns)
t-7022.body: Cathedral Park lawn, screen goes up at eight, film at dusk. Bring a blanket. Food carts on site. Rain date Saturday.

replies.author: hawthorne_hh
replies.body: Is it dog friendly?

replies.author: gigs.pdx
replies.body: Leashed dogs are fine.

t-7023.author: alice-pdx
t-7023.title: Neighbourhood cleanup Saturday 9am, coffee provided (Alder District)
t-7023.body: Meet at the corner of Kearney and 11th. Bags and grabbers supplied, bring gloves. Two hours, then coffee at Northlight. Kids welcome.

t-7024.author: tuneup_tony
t-7024.title: Mobile bike tune-up at your door - $60 (all east side)
t-7024.body: Full tune: brakes, gears, true wheels, bearings check, chain wear. Parts extra at cost. Weekends and weekday evenings. Twelve years wrenching in shops, now on my own.

replies.author: bob_m
replies.body: Booked him for two bikes last month. Showed up on time, both shift like new.

t-7025.author: stjohns_mike
t-7025.title: Handyman: fences, gates, decks, small repairs - hourly (St. Johns)
t-7025.body: Licensed and insured. Fences and gates are the speciality; also drywall patches, door hanging, gutter cleaning. Free estimate on anything over two hours. Photos of recent work on request.

t-7026.author: carol_nk
t-7026.title: Math tutoring, algebra through calculus, in person or online - $45/hr (Belmont)
t-7026.body: Engineering degree, six years tutoring high school and first-year college students. First half hour free to see if we get along. Evenings and weekends.
